sections: Items purchased on Dillards.com that are eligible for return can be returned within 30 calendar days from the purchase date to the Internet Store location, 600 Carnahan Drive, Maumelle, AR 72113, or to any Dillard's store (excluding Clearance Centers). Electronic items, kid's gear, and shoes must be returned in the original packing material from the manufacturer.

The following items are non-returnable and non-exchangeable: (1) clearance merchandise marked down 65% or more; (2) merchandise on sale with an additional discount, e.g. items marked down 25% or more and then discounted an additional 50% off; (3) altered or customized merchandise; (4) items classified as final sale on Dillards.com; (5) gift cards and e-gift cards; and (6) body jewelry, cosmetics and fragrances if the original seal is broken.

Bring any merchandise eligible for return to a Dillard's location near you (excluding clearance centers), along with your receipt or proof of purchase. Proof of purchase or POP labels accompany every item sold to help us track sales and returns. Items purchased in store have the yellow label physically attached. For items purchased on Dillards.com, POP information is included on the Order Status email sent when items are shipped.

Find the order on your Order History or look up your In-Store or Online purchase. Click 'Start Return' and select the items you are sending back. Dillard's offers a return label you can print from your computer and attach to the return package. The use of Dillard's return label is $9.95. Re-pack the merchandise along with your receipt with Proof of Purchase. Your refund will be credited to your original method of payment.
Merchandise exchanges are accepted at any Dillard's store location (excluding clearance centers) within 30 calendar days of purchase with proof of purchase.

benefits: Open a Dillard's Credit Card account and earn a 10% Off Welcome Shopping Pass with your first statement when you make $100 in purchases with your Dillard's Credit Card at Dillard's on the day you're approved (max $100 discount).
Get 2 points per $1 spent at Dillard's on net eligible purchases with your Dillard's Credit Card or Dillard's Mastercard.
With the Dillard's Mastercard, earn 2 points per $1 at U.S. gas stations, 2 points per $1 at U.S. supermarkets and grocery stores, and 1 point per $1 on all other purchases.
Earn 1,500 points for your choice of a 10% Off One-Day Shopping Pass or a $10 Rewards Certificate.
Welcome Shopping Pass and Shopping Passes are valid for a 10% discount on one day's eligible purchases made at Dillard's by 11:59 p.m. Central Time on the day used.
Welcome Shopping Pass has a $100 maximum discount. Passes cannot be combined with Dillard's percentage-off coupons or Rewards Certificates.
Special Financing Offers on qualifying purchases are included with the Dillard's Credit Card.
Dillard's Mastercard includes exclusive Mastercard priceless experiences and special offers.
Manage your account online at dillards.com. Subject to credit approval.

Track an order from your Order History, or start a return within 30 days of purchase. See the Return Policy page for the full policy.
Customer safety is our first priority. Recall notices are published as soon as they are announced.

brands.name: A Loves A
brands.about: a loves a strives to emulate Parisian chic styling through elevated classics and fashion. The line provides a strong, casual modern line with updated contemporary details. The aesthetic evokes classic femininity and effortless styling for the perfect blend of easy to wear everyday pieces with an impeccable attention to quality and timelessness.

brands.name: Adrianna Papell
brands.about: The style destination for every woman, and every occasion. Wear life beautifully. Adrianna Papell, founded in NYC in 1980, began as a vision to help all women feel their most beautiful—creating soft silk dresses and blouses in artful prints. The company fast evolved from featuring daytime and occasion dresses to elegant evening and cocktail wear. As demand continued for refined fashion that celebrates life’s most meaningful experiences, Adrianna Papell responded, becoming a style destination for every woman and every occasion.

brands.name: Alex Evenings
brands.about: Alex Evenings was founded on one simple idea: that eveningwear should reflect YOU, the amazing woman wearing it. We believe that in order for you to look and feel beautiful at your next important event, the PERFECT FIT is paramount. Our mission is to ensure that you find exactly-the-right dress for every special occasion. Our dresses and separates accentuate your curves while disguising flaws. Our dress collection is engineered for REAL SHAPES. It’s all about the fabric! Our dresses feature innovative materials that STRETCH and move with your body to make you look great in all the right places. We create designs that compliment EVERY BODY-TYPE — including petites and plus-sizes. It’s you, just a bit better. Our designs are CAMERA-READY. Images of your next special event will be with you for a lifetime, so we take extra care to create dresses that will help you appear stunning in front of the lens.

brands.name: Alex Marie
brands.about: Alex Marie was created with the modern woman in mind. She is stylish, feminine, and polished. She appreciates pieces that have great quality and a comfortable fit. She is a woman on the go and needs a wardrobe that works for her, wherever the day takes her. This Dillard’s exclusive brand truly showcases a versatile collection for any lifestyle.

brands.name: Antonio Melani
brands.about: Curated high end collections that evoke sophistication through tailoring, yet stay current through styling and attitude. Antonio Melani caters to the modern woman's career and social schedule with an emphasis on luxury fabrications.

brands.name: Ariat
brands.about: In 1993, Ariat set out to revolutionize footwear for riders. We understood that traditional cowboy boots were stiff, heavy and hard on the feet so we assembled a group of top footwear engineers and designers, and created the world's most technically-innovative boots for riding and ranch use. Today, Ariat is the world leader in performance cowboy boots, denim, tops and outerwear, worn by top riders and influencers worldwide. Our point of difference is functional innovation—materials, technologies and constructions that deliver comfort and performance enhancements in everyday western and work wear. WE BELIEVE IN: INNOVATION. Ariat® was founded on technology and innovation — with the goal of making the highest-quality footwear and apparel for the world’s top equestrian athletes. DEDICATION. We are a community of riders and people committed to those who ride, ranch, and work outdoors. We make products we’re proud to use. BALANCE. We play as hard as we work. And playing includes family, friends, and living outdoors. RIDERS AS ATHLETES. As athletes, riders put their bodies to the test every day. We create high performance boots and apparel that keep up. POSSIBILITIES. We strive to redesign, re-imagine, and reshape our world, while staying true to the values and traditions that keep us authentic.

brands.name: Aromatique
brands.about: Our Story Aromatique, The Creator of Decorative Fragrance®, is situated in the foothills of the Ozark Mountains between the sparkling waters of Greers Ferry Lake and the Little Red River. It is born from a single inspired idea of Aromatique’s founder, Patti Upton. In its purest form, Patti’s vision was combining the senses of sight and smell to make great fragrances beautiful. By combining high-end fragrances with artfully arranged botanicals, these decorative fragrance products are valued in the home as well as for gifts. This singular idea not only gave birth to Patti’s first product, The Smell of Christmas®, and to her company, Aromatique, Inc.®, but also to an entirely new industry, the Decorative Fragrance Industry. It can be argued that the vast majority of all the home fragrance brands that exist today are tied to the vision of Patti Upton and the success of Aromatique. Today continuing its fragrance legacy, Aromatique is a brand respected throughout the industry and sought after by some of the finest retailers in the world. Our Mission Being a family owned company, we concentrate on creating a path to memories near and far. We focus on togetherness and reflect art and innovation in our day to day practices; purposely expanding ways to experience fragrance. Our Vision We operate across the United States, from Arkansas to New York manufacturing all categories of home fragrance, celebrating the tradition and passion of hand-crafted artisanship. We are based on the thought that fragrance and art are one in the same and that a meticulously developed fragrance can rejuvenate the soul.

brands.name: B. Darlin
brands.about: B. Darlin provides easy, affordable and elegant dresses for many events. Take in our stunning fabrics for special occasions as well as our fashionable fabrics for everyday wear. Check out B. Darlin dresses for all.

brands.name: Badgley Mischka
brands.about: Over the past thirty years, Badgley Mischka has flourished into a true lifestyle brand recognizable worldwide. By remaining true to their design philosophy and the consistent integrity of their collections, Mark Badgley and James Mischka have made their mark over the past three decades with glamorous, stylish and wearable evening wear and accessories that appeal to a wide range of fashionable women including Madonna, Jennifer Lopez, Sharon Stone, Jennifer Garner, Julia Roberts, Kate Winslet, Helen Mirren, Taylor Swift, Sarah Jessica Parker and Carrie Underwood.

brands.name: Bayeas
brands.about: Since the ’90s, Bayeas has been a family-owned brand dedicated to creating denim for EVERYbody. Blending comfort, versatility, and style, our jeans are designed to move with you and fit your life. From everyday essentials to fashion-forward favorites, Bayeas offers wearable, premium pieces that feel as good as they look.

brands.name: Birkenstock
brands.about: Iconic, German-made brand Birkenstock is well known (and loved) for their one-of-a-kind contoured cork foot-bed, which provides all-day comfort and support. Since 1774 they've created thoughtful, high-quality products - from sandals, shoes and socks to skincare - all focused on holistic wellness. Human-centered design and renewable materials complete this heritage brand's approach to overall well-being.

brands.name: Blondie Nites
brands.about: At Blondie Nites, we know exactly what is needed for every special occasion because we have been at it for generations. We create dresses that fit, flare and sculpt for amazing entrances, stunning pictures... and having fun too. The fabrics we choose and silhouettes we design are always the latest trends from just the right dress length, slit height and exposed shoulders in all the right colors. All of our dresses are designed in New York City inspired by its vibrant nightlife, social galas, and fashion runway shows. We also make the majority of our dresses close to home in the NYC Garment District, New Jersey and Brooklyn. We never skimp on style and especially never skimp on quality. “Our success has always been product product product. We pride ourselves on our styling, fit and quality. You can tell me a dress didn’t sell because of the style. Don’t tell me it was because the dress wasn’t made right.” Michael Sklar CEO Each season we launch a new collection of the latest trends in evening wear as well as updated popular styles that become long standing classics. Founded in 1982 by our father, Marty Sklar, our family owned and operated business along with one of the most talented teams in New York City, is one of the largest makers of formalwear for over 25 years in the U.S. So one might say, we know how to make you look special.

brands.name: BRAHMIN
brands.about: WHO WE ARE We’re proud to be a true-to-our-roots brand with a big vision. 100 percent of our products are designed in Massachusetts using luxury leathers from Italy and around the globe. OUR NAME BRAH·MIN/BRÄMƏN/ New England: a term used to describe someone who is cultured and of the most discerning taste. Today, our name simply conveys our mission: to create high-quality, handcrafted products that stand the test of time — and look the part.

brands.name: BuDhaGirl
brands.about: BuDhaGirl is a lifestyle brand at the intersection of beauty, ritual, and intention. Founded in 2013 by Jessica Jesse, BuDhaGirl was born from the belief that what we wear can be more than beautiful—it can be meaningful. Each piece is designed to turn daily routines into mindful rituals, inviting the wearer to begin and end each day with purpose.From our iconic, award-winning All Weather Bangles® to seasonal limited editions, BuDhaGirl jewelry blends modern design with the ancient practice of intention-setting. Waterproof, weightless, soundless, and TSA-proof, each bangle is handcrafted by over 20 artisans in Thailand and built to be lived in. More than jewelry, BuDhaGirl is a ritual for living well—rooted in self-reflection, gratitude, and the power of presence. Join a global community of women who collect, gift, and share BuDhaGirl as a symbol of connection, joy, and mindful living.

brands.name: Buru
brands.about: BURU is a delightful line of small-batch apparel designed in Los Angeles and led by the ethos that one should make the most out of every opportunity to get dressed. With collections centered around bold textiles, whimsical prints, unique-yet-versatile silhouettes and playful use of color, the brand is known for its fun approach to fashion and 'wear what you want, when you want' point of view. Each piece is thoughtfully designed to blend function with fashion and versatility with sophistication in a way that earns a space in the modern woman's wardrobe through the many seasons of life and style.

brands.name: Cariloha
brands.about: Cariloha Is Bamboo Since 2007, Cariloha has grown to become a globally recognized brand with a retail, wholesale and online presence specializing in bedding, clothing and bath goods made of comfortable, sustainable viscose from bamboo. By turning self-replenishing bamboo fields into luxuriously soft, earth-friendly bamboo-viscose fabrics, Cariloha offers an exclusive collection of bedding, apparel, activewear, bath goods, and more made from this soft, cool, clean, and green fabric. Inspired by the essence and energy of the islands, Cariloha blends style and self-expression into every piece of clothing and bedding it makes. Special care is taken to drape customers in soft, comfortable, sustainable bamboo-viscose fabrics that leave them experiencing tranquil days in paradise time and time again. Thanks to an ever-growing, rich supply of bamboo, Cariloha has an expansive fleet of retail showrooms in 17 countries offering its proprietary apparel, bedding and bath goods – all enjoying the quality, soft touch, and green ‘footprint’ of this sustainable, renewable resource.

brands.name: Cezanne
brands.about: Is it real or is it Cezanne? We won’t tell if you won’t. Our line of “fine costume” jewelry adds a touch of glamour to life. The collection consists of everyday classics to red-carpet worthy pieces for special occasions. We believe that you don’t have to spend a lot to look like a million bucks.

brands.name: COACH
brands.about: Who we are. Coach is a global fashion house founded in New York in 1941. Inspired by the vision of Creative Director Stuart Vevers and the inclusive and courageous spirit of our hometown, we make beautiful things, crafted to last—for you to be yourself in. What we believe. We believe in crafting beautiful things that you can be yourself in. Since 1941, inspired by the spirit of our hometown, New York City, we’ve built a legacy of craft and a community that champions the courage to live authentically. Today, the same way we care about every stitch that goes into our product, we care about the impact we have on people, communities and the planet. Everything we make, we craft to last with the belief that better-made things create a better made future for all.

brands.name: Cole Haan
brands.about: Trafton Cole and Eddie Haan began Cole Haan in 1928, resolving to make good goods and nothing but good goods. Their entrepreneurial spirit and timeless vision inspire us still. Today we create the shoes, bags, and finishing touches for people who are ingenuous, resourceful and want to make a difference. Our intrepid tribe manages to look good whether at work or play, and believes a sense of style and a sense of humor are the perfect complements.

brands.name: Cremieux
brands.about: Crémieux is a family owned luxury menswear company, founded in Saint-Tropez by Daniel Cremieux, South of France in 1976. Apart from Saint-Tropez, Cremieux has stores in Paris, London, New York, Capri, and Palm Beach. From day one, the brand has focused on designing high quality garments that are timeless, fun and colorful. Now managed by Stephane Crémieux, the brand uses the most sophisticated, high-quality materials from all over the world to create his collections. These collections are proudly tailored in the best factories with experts to execute the vision in their workmanship. All Cremieux products in the United States are exclusively sold at Dillard's and Cremieux stores.

brands.name: Dior
brands.about: Founded by Christian Dior, the Dior fashion house was established in December 1946, and the freshman launched his first collection in 1947 at their Parisian headquarters. Both Christian Dior and his luxury brand quickly rose to the forefront of the high-fashion world, becoming one of the most influential fashion houses of the century. The luxury fashion house continues to create products evoking timeless luxury and quality innovation. Dior's first perfume, Miss Dior, evolved into an entire skincare line, fragrance, and cosmetics that express a timeless devotion to sensual femininity. Christian Dior's legacy lives on through his Dior brand and remains one of the most prominent and significant fashion houses of our time.

brands.name: Eileen Fisher
brands.about: Our line is designed as a system of simple shapes in quality fabrics that work together year after year so you can build a wardrobe that keeps working for you over time. For over 35 years, we’ve been united in our efforts to support the environment, human rights and initiatives for women and girls – and we believe this work is becoming more and more important.

brands.name: ELLIATT
brands.about: ELLIATT is a female-founded Australian business designing looks for women to feel confident, beautiful, and empowered. ELLIATT's design manifesto is rooted in creating high-quality, modern, and feminine garments for every occasion.Founded by Katie Pratt in 2010, ELLIATT was born from her passion for sewing and an esteemed career in fashion. ELLIATT was first conceptualized in Sydney, Australia, where Katie built the business from the ground up. Having a background in millinery and occasion 'Dress Focused' design, Katie has turned her love for dressing up into a global brand.

brands.name: Estee Lauder
brands.about: We see beauty everywhere. We have for generations. And we want to preserve that beauty for generations to come. Inspired by our founder, Mrs. Estée Lauder, we are passionate about representing and serving women around the world, wherever and whomever they may be. That means a commitment to developing products that are of the highest quality and performance, while also being responsible, trustworthy, and giving back to our community.

brands.name: Faherty
brands.about: Inspired by the sun, Faherty is a family brand all about great quality, legendary comfort and good vibes. We are fueled by purpose and leaving the world better than we found it.

brands.name: Fossil
brands.about: Fossil has always been inspired by American creativity and ingenuity. Since 1984, we’ve strived to bring new life into the industry by making quality, fashionable watches and accessories that were both fun and accessible. Today, we continue to focus on what makes us, us: optimism, authenticity and, of course, our creative spirit. Everything we make complements every style and fits every lifestyle - for all the moments that make you, you.

brands.name: Free People
brands.about: At Free People we draw, design, cut, and sew for the FP girl. From hand-stitched seams to romantic lace inserts, she will find love and care in the vintage-inspired details. The brand is consistently developing exclusive washes and distressing techniques to give each style its coveted modern edge. The goal is to gather inspiration from the past and interpret it for the modern girl in a way that makes her feel beautiful and one-of-a-kind. View Free People Size Chart

brands.name: GB
brands.about: GB is a brand exclusive to Dillard’s, that offers contemporary, spirited, and fun collections. The GB girl is trendy, adventurous, and up to date on all things fashion. She is social and is always on the hunt for the perfect outfit inspo. Everything from GB is created with this in mind. From fun printed pieces to classic wardrobe staples, we pride ourselves on offering the highest quality, on-trend clothing, shoes, and more.

brands.name: Gianni Bini
brands.about: Gianni Bini is a contemporary collection that is always on the forefront of fashion, offering styles that exude high quality and satiate the constant craving for the newest, most cutting-edge trends. Gianni Bini aspires to always offer fresh, yet seasonally relevant collections that cater to all aspects of the contemporary woman’s life. Gianni Bini is committed to using the “latest and greatest” when it comes to materials, design, sourcing, and technology. Together with our creative and design teams, we travel the world in search of the freshest and most exciting inspiration. Gianni Bini designers stay on the pulse of all emerging trends from the high-end runways right down to the streets of New York, Los Angeles, Paris, London, and Milan.

brands.name: Gibson & Latimer
brands.about: Gibson & Latimer is an exclusive women's collection, providing trend forward fashion collections to the Dillard's customer at an accessible price. The Gibson & Latimer woman is ageless; styling is contemporary and trend forward yet fit to her body type. Gibson & Latimer aspires to always offer fresh & seasonally relevant collections that cater to the everyday woman.

brands.name: Gucci
brands.about: Gucci is one the most renowned and inﬂuential luxury brands in the world today, a genuine global reference for fashion and accessories. Founded in Florence in 1921, Gucci is famous for eclectic and contemporary creations that represent the pinnacle of Italian craftsmanship and are unsurpassed in quality, attention to detail and imaginative design.

brands.name: HOBO
brands.about: Born in 1991 on Toni Ray’s dining room table, HOBO is a second generation, family-run brand. Rooted in quality & craft, we design with intention. Weaving together beauty, soul, & purpose to craft the leather goods you reach for every day for their style & function. Built for a long term relationship and made better with use & wear. Connecting us all along our journey, to life’s next great discovery.

brands.name: Honey and Rosie
brands.about: Honey and Rosie is a collection for the true dress enthusiast. They are the go-to source for the sophisticated young girl who is a modern fashion fan. She can throw on a dress and be ready for anything. Whether you need a dress for an occasion, a dance, tea with the girls, or frolicking around town, Honey and Rosie will add sparkle and sass to any wardrobe. Honey and Rosie was founded in Downtown Los Angeles in 2012, by two friends. It was their mission to create a fun, creative work environment where entrepreneurial women could flourish. Inspired by vintage fashion photos of their families, they share a vision of creating dresses which are reminiscent of classic vintage Los Angeles beauties and are sprinkled with modern savvy glam.

brands.name: Investments
brands.about: Investments is a polished related separates brand focused on giving our customer timeless style, everyday value, and consistency of fit. Our brand is thoughtfully designed to transcend trends, available in a range of prints and colorways that invite personalization and lasting appeal. Sophisticated, classic, and easy to wear, Investments makes dressing effortless, offering versatile and refined pieces that simplify wardrobing and inspire confidence season after season.

brands.name: Jeffrey Campbell
brands.about: Jeffrey Campbell is an independent shoe brand that pushes the boundaries of contemporary style. Based in Los Angeles, the company's intimate team reacts to the feelings and inspirations of their peers. With the hope to empower individuals through progressive silhouettes and achievable looks, the JC mission is to make bold footwear for everyone at an accessible price. Working towards a more inclusive and relatable future

brands.name: John Mark
brands.about: JOHN MARK is a relaxed collection of tops and bottoms bound together in subtle color stories. The styles are comfortable and casual, most in natural fibers of cotton, linen and silk. They are blends of woven and knits, which perfectly suits the modern woman’s lifestyle. The JOHN MARK clothing line line is fresh, up-to-date and fashion forward. The true essence of the JOHN MARK brand is livable luxury lifestyle: showcasing easy-wear separates with specialty accents that emphasize style & innovation. The JOHN MARK line is not inhibited by just solids. Instead, this collection marries novelty with subtlety for the ideal expressive wardrobe. This group of easy-wear body shapes compliments the timeless customer in both work and home life with a seamless transition.

brands.name: Johnnie-O
brands.about: We are a brand built on juxtaposition—traditional East Coast styles loosened up with a laid-back West Coast influence and some Midwest grit for good measure. With this in mind, we embrace the classics but infuse them with a spirit that is always unexpected.

brands.name: Johnston & Murphy
brands.about: Johnston & Murphy is a timeless American icon and lifestyle brand offering men’s, women’s and boys footwear, apparel and accessories. Founded in 1850, the brand has over 175 company-owned stores and can be found in more than 2,000 premium department and specialty stores across the U.S. and Canada. Johnston & Murphy’s mission is to create modern interpretations of classics that are uncompromising in quality and value. The brand has served as shoemaker to every American President since Millard Fillmore in 1850.

brands.name: KARL LAGERFELD PARIS
brands.about: AS ONE OF THE WORLD’S MOST CELEBRATED FASHION DESIGNERS, KARL LAGERFELD WAS RENOWNED FOR HIS ASPIRATIONAL AND CUTTING-EDGE APPROACH TO STYLE. KARL LAGERFELD PARIS IS A REFLECTION OF THE DESIGNER’S SIGNATURE AESTHETIC THROUGH CREATIVE, COOL AND ACCESSIBLE APPAREL, HANDBAGS, SHOES AND ACCESSORIES. IT’S THE PRESTIGE OF PARISIAN CHIC FOR THE AMERICAN WOMAN.

brands.name: kate spade new york
brands.about: it all started back in 1993, when kate brosnahan spade, a former accessories editor at mademoiselle, set out to design the perfect handbag. debuting with just six silhouettes, she combined sleek, utilitarian shapes and colorful palettes in an entirely new way. and so kate spade new york was born. women and fashion editors fell for the fresh, modern sensibility, and our first shop in new york city swiftly opened in 1996. as the company grew, our graphic approach and trademark wit created a visual shorthand for a brand recognizable the world over. in 2007, spade turned the reins to design powerhouse kate spade & company (formerly known as liz claiborne, inc.). shortly after, deborah lloyd took the helm as president and chief creative officer with an aim to broaden the line while honoring our rich history. along with ceo craig leavitt, she quickly launched clothing and jewelry collections, quickly followed by the introduction of bedding, legwear and fragrance. today we’ve grown into a global lifestyle brand, and aim to inspire colorful living through our handbags and clothing to jewelry, shoes, stationery, eyewear, baby, fragrance, tabletop, bedding and gifts. all the while, we’ve never lost sight of who we are: our spirited approach, commitment to curiosity and passion for sharing our colorful world still shapes all that is kate spade new york. live colorfully

brands.name: KatieJNYC
brands.about: As a mom of three (two girls), I saw the need for Tween and Junior Lux Intimates My Comfort, style, quality and practicality!My daughter was 14 but couldn't fit in the Woman's department yet. Going to the store to get undergarments, bras's apparel to say the least, WAS NOT EASY! I was tired of our aimless shopping only to find uncomfortable, unstylish and well ( so not cool) undergarments and ill-fitting clothes designed for woman. We finally decided to launch KatieJnyc and offer a tween and Teen category that was well overdue. Tween and Teen Lux intimate and apparel was born! With age appropriate style, tweens and Junior Girls can feel pretty, comfortable and trendy while transitioning . Our “Katie Bra” features the highest quality, smooth fabric for tee-shirt wearing, memory foam padding as well as tag-less for comfort (ugh itchy tags), in addition to the flexibility of halter, racer and regular wear. As of our launch in October of 2017, KatieJnyc is selling in over 50 stores nationwide

brands.name: Kendra Scott
brands.about: Fashion, Family & Philanthropy. Through the use of natural materials, including genuine stone and shell, we create quality, affordable luxury products that make fashion and its trends truly accessible. Our products are thoughtfully crafted in our Austin, Texas studio, pushing the boundaries of design and innovation while staying true to our principles: color, shape, material, and value.

brands.name: Kurt Geiger London
brands.about: Kurt Geiger is a leading London-based footwear and accessories retailer powered by creativity and kindness. For over fifty years, Kurt Geiger’s in-house team of shoe and accessory designers have endeavoured to embolden customers through statement styles underpinned by London’s vibrance and authenticity. Its ultimate mission to create a kind, diverse and inclusive fashion community propels the regular launch of kindness-driven initiatives supporting people, charities and global movements.

brands.name: Lancome
brands.about: Lancôme successfully combines scientific expertise and an intuitive understanding of women's needs to produce major innovations, unique and complementary between skincare, makeup and perfume. Lancôme affirms that happiness is the most attractive beauty. More than ever before, the brand aims to offer every woman the possibility to blossom and embrace her beauty and femininity whatever her age or skin color.

brands.name: Lauren Ralph Lauren
brands.about: LAUREN RALPH LAUREN Timeless Ralph Lauren style—dresses, tops, denim, accessories, and more—for work, the weekend, and every moment in between.

brands.name: Le' AL.X
brands.about: Le' AL.X explores meticulous design that speaks to a minimalist aesthetic, creating an elevated casual collection. A vision conceived from the idea of refined pieces, thebrand blends timeless styles with progressive contemporary silhouettes, featuring subtle detailing and exceptional fabrics. Le' AL.X embodies the appeal of a modern uniform,offering an ever-evolving wardrobe.

brands.name: Levi's
brands.about: Close your eyes. Think “jeans.” Now open. They were Levi’s®, right? Since inventing the very first pair back in 1873, the legacy heritage brand has been woven into the very fabric of American history and culture, epitomizing classic style and effortless cool. Today, Levi’s® is the ultimate in denim authority and a worldwide apparel phenomenon, selling tops, bottoms, outerwear, accessories and more. Relevant as ever, their innovative and pioneering spirit continues to evolve with every generation, becoming more and more sustainable, from products to practices—making it easier for everyone to buy better and wear what they buy longer.

brands.name: Lilly Pulitzer
brands.about: In 1959, Lilly Pulitzer set out to create her own happiness, opening a juice stand in Palm Beach, FL.In need of an everyday uniform, she asked her dressmaker for something to camouflage splashes of citrus juice. The result was a comfortable, sleeveless shift dress made of colorful printed cotton. Since those early days, Lilly designs have been beloved for their casual glamour, vibrant optimism, and endlessly joyful spirit. Lilly was an original with the confidence to break all the rules, the humility to pull it off, and the vision to make women feel as good as they look. Today, her spirit is reflected in the brand’s distinctive prints and lively colors, which inspire everyone to shine bright and stand out.

brands.name: Liverpool Los Angeles
brands.about: Liverpool offers premium fashion styles that are on-trend & relatable. Designed to make your life easier by offering a consistent fit that is always comfortable & reliable at an exceptional value. Our goal is to inspire you to heightened levels of empowerment, self-expression & confidence.

brands.name: Lucky Brand
brands.about: Rooted in irreverence, rock n’ roll culture, & the spirit of rebellion, Lucky brand has been championing individuality for 30 years. Staying true to its rich heritage & the all-American spirit of denim, Lucky Brand stands for originality, soul, and authenticity. With a bit of edge and a lot of heart, we embody the independent spirit. Lucky Brand was born in the heart of downtown Los Angeles in 1990. The brand began by crafting great-fitting, vintage-inspired jeans and giving them a distinctive worn & weathered look to create true character. Denim is our heart & soul, and everything beyond is grounded in this unique attitude with a focus on iconic, updated classics.

brands.name: Lucy Paris
brands.about: Lucy Paris makes clothing for women, inspired by women: women on the go, women who empower, women who do it all! Our brand story begins with Lucy, the curator of our brand. Lucy was born in Paris, raised in New York, and currently in Los Angeles. Since launching in 2003, the line has evolved around giving women the “ideal wardrobe”. The brand focuses on feminine pieces and intricate details that are reflective of the city girl lifestyle. Lucy Paris blends together Parisian elegance, with a New York state of mind, and California cool. Each Lucy Paris piece is thoughtfully made for women who are fashion forward, confident, and effortless. Taking inspiration from Paris, New York, and Los Angeles, the collection is designed as an homage to the women from these cities: the ladies who brunch, work 9 to 5, live to travel, plan their outfits, post photos of their outfits, love happy hour and dinner parties. Simply put: women who love life and do it all. xoxo - Lucy Paris

brands.name: Lulus
brands.about: Our exclusive styles are made with you in mind. We buy and design sophisticated, chic and modern styles we know you'll love. We invest in superior construction and high-end finishes to make your Lulus purchase a true representation of affordable luxury.

brands.name: Murano
brands.about: Immaculate fit in both classic and slim silhouettes, along with contemporary wearability, offer a versatile hybrid wardrobe shaped around the lifestyle of today's modern man. Modern, not trendy -- refined, not conventional --timeless and elegant.

brands.name: MZ Wallace
brands.about: Founded in NYC, MZ Wallace creates luxury handbags with timeless design and innovative function. Discover high-end bags crafted for the modern, on-the-go lifestyle. We believe in design that does more, so you can do more. From our high-quality, sustainable materials to our timeless style and perfectly-placed pockets, our bags equip you to take on your day — for wherever you're going.

brands.name: NEST New York
brands.about: Scent your world with NEST New York’s fragranced home, personal care, wellness, and technology collections. Recognized by the fragrance industry as a game changer, founder Laura Slatkin has a unique approach to fragrance, artfully blending notes of the familiar, the exotic, and the unexpected for a fragrance experience like no other.

brands.name: Never Fully Dressed
brands.about: Never Fully Dressed is more than just a fashion brand. We’re a community that celebrates, empowers and supports everybody. We want you to feel represented in our brand, through diverse models, to inclusive sizing that extends from a UK 6-28 / US 2-24.We encourage feel good dressing, that clothing has the power to change how we feel. Our unique prints in quality fabrics are designed in-house to inject joy into your wardrobe and inspire confidence in your every day.We have a vision of designing clothes with a multi wear function, creating styles that are investment pieces with longevity for all occasions and seasons. Our honest price structure signifies the quality of our product whilst maintaining its affordability.We believe in making fashion accessible for all.Our customer is our influencer. We are inspired by our community and value their voice in our brand. We actively encourage supportive conversation across our channels.

brands.name: New Balance
brands.about: At New Balance, our job is to aid athletes in their pursuits, whether that means helping professional athletes set records and win medals, or propelling everyday athletes to achieve a new PR, run their first 5K or just to live a more healthy and active lifestyle. Our products are the perfect blend of function and fashion, giving you the performance technology you need and the style you want. While we offer the best product on the market, we’re also equally committed to giving back. So while we look to succeed, we believe in ensuring others have the same opportunity.

brands.name: Polo Ralph Lauren
brands.about: Defining modern luxury and timeless style since 1967. A family affair, Ralph Lauren offers collections for men, women, and children along with fragrance and home furnishings. The epitome of classic American style, Ralph Lauren is known around the globe for quality craftsmanship and enduring elegance. Men's Polo combines Ivy League classics and time-honored English haberdashery with downtown styles and all-American sporting looks in sportswear and tailored clothing. Polo Ralph Lauren Children is designed to reflect the timeless heritage and modern spirit of Ralph Lauren's collections for men and women. Polo's signature aesthetic includes our renowned polo player logo. “What I do is about living the best life you can and enjoying the fullness of the life around you. From what you wear to the way you live to the way you love.” - Ralph Lauren-

brands.name: Preston & York
brands.about: Preston & York offers a wardrobing destination for the traditional woman, with collections ranging from well tailored suiting and separates, to polished casual pieces. With a timeless point of view, sophisticated styling, and a consistent fit, Preston & York offers classic refinement that caters to all areas of the traditional woman's lifestyle.

brands.name: RHONE
brands.about: We’re a brand that’s here to make a positive difference, to inspire, equip and support those who are on a journey to build and maintain physical and mental fitness. Our purpose is simple, yet powerful. Rhone is performance driven apparel made by and for those in the pursuit of progress.

brands.name: Roundtree & Yorke
brands.about: A truly classic take on everyday menswear. Providing essential sportswear with the goal of exceptional quality for the price. Traditional styling and refined silhouettes make everyday garments a comfortable and handsome clothing choice.

brands.name: Sam Edelman
brands.about: Aspirational Luxury with an Irreverent and Trend-on Style. Since 2004, Sam Edelman has been synonymous with aspirational luxury. Inspired by timeless American elegance, Sam Edelman’s innate understanding of the customer translates conceptually into a modern lifestyle informed by rich heritage, creativity, and innovation. A visionary and pioneer in contemporary fashion, Sam Edelman interprets the changing landscape of today to deliver irreverent and trend-on style for tomorrow.

brands.name: Scully
brands.about: The Scully brand has been an apparel mainstay since 1906. For over 100 years, Scully has been on the cutting edge of fashion, and has been pertinent to several fashion trends along the way. The styling is always innovative and enduring, a bit “boho” and somewhat “artsy,” energetic and intense. Scully’s mixed media fashions make every piece unique. Creativity is evident in the wide variety of fabrics and selections of colors, embroidery design and fascinating prints. The skins for their leather styles are carefully selected and constructed with a great deal of attention to detail and care. Whether looking for that perfect piece for going out on the town or getting out of town to enjoy the great outdoors, Scully has the fashion that fits your mood. Scully…..Quality forever….since 1906.

brands.name: Seiko
brands.about: Seiko is a world leader in the watch industry dedicated to perfection and focused on innovation, quality, and craftsmanship. Seiko is one of the few fully integrated watch manufactures. We design and develop our own movements using leading-edge technology. Founded in 1881, it is known for introducing one of the world's first quartz wrist watches as well as the world's first quartz watch with a chronograph complication. Seiko's watchmaking experience and expertise ensures that its watches are of superior quality at every price point.

brands.name: Skies Are Blue
brands.about: The epitome of Americana Chic, SKIES ARE BLUE offers easy-to-wear, sophisticated pieces for the everyday woman.

brands.name: Southern Living
brands.about: The pages of the iconic magazine come to life in the Southern Living Collection. Each piece reflects our appreciation for effortlessly classic southern style. We believe in using “the good stuff” any day of the week, creating everyday heirlooms that earn a cherished place in our homes and jewelry boxes. Our love for celebrating both the big moments and the small is reflected in every piece we design.

brands.name: Steve Madden
brands.about: What began as a modest $1100 investment in 1990 has developed into one of the most iconic brands in footwear. From a factory in Queens, NY, Steve Madden has revolutionized the shoe industry, merging years of experience with unique and creative designs. Inspired by rock and roll and his New York roots, his vision to provide on-trend women and men with an outlet to express their individuality is innovative, daring, and inspiring. Steve’s innate understanding of trends and unparalleled willpower have resulted in millions of customers worldwide and propelled his designs to the forefront of fashion. He has expanded the Steve Madden brand into a true lifestyle and destination for footwear, handbags and accessories, sold in over 80 countries worldwide. It’s about authenticity. It’s about embracing individuality. It’s Steve Madden.

brands.name: Timberland
brands.about: Timberland is a global outdoor lifestyle brand based in Stratham, New Hampshire, with international headquarters in Switzerland and Hong Kong. Best known for its original yellow boot introduced in 1973 to take on the harsh elements of New England, Timberland today offers a full range of footwear, apparel and accessories for people who value purposeful style and share the brand’s passion for enjoying – and protecting – Nature. At the heart of the Timberland® brand is the core belief that a greener future is a better future. This comes to life through a decades-long commitment to make products responsibly, protect the outdoors, and strengthen communities around the world. The brand has committed to plant 50 million trees worldwide by 2025, and has a bold vision for its products to have a net positive impact on Nature by 2030, giving back more than they take

brands.name: Tissot
brands.about: Men's & Women's Luxury Watches. Crafted With Swiss Precision, Styled With Timeless Elegance. All Tissot watches are fully Swiss-made. This means that the parts are sourced locally, the movement used is also Swiss, and the assembly and inspection are also being done in Switzerland. Tissot is a long-established brand that is well-known for producing great quality watches.

brands.name: Tommy Bahama
brands.about: Get that island feeling - no island required. We encourage you to live spontaneously and relax in style, no matter where you are. Our products are here to ease you into an island state of mind.

brands.name: UGG
brands.about: UGG is defined for those who refuse to be defined by convention Founded in 1978 on the coast of California by an Australian surfer, UGG is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic boot. First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors, and then the world, UGG has expanded beyond the icon to design footwear, apparel, accessories, and home decor. The brand has always celebrated unapologetic individuality with an uncompromising attitude towards creativity, quality, and craftsmanship, bold, provocative, free-spirited, optimistic, and authentic. It continues to be embraced globally by those who refuse to be defined by convention.

brands.name: Vince Camuto
brands.about: Vince Camuto is a global lifestyle brand recognized for quality materials and on-trend designs. Their modern collections feature distinctive designs, exceptional materials, expert craftsmanship and unparalleled value. Known for its well-crafted and fashion-forward aesthetic, Vince Camuto collections fuse designer wear and fast-fashion for accessible luxury.

products.name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE EAU DE PARFUM SPRAY
products.description: PRODUCT Irresistibly sensual, irrepressibly spirited. A sparkling, bold floral-woody fragrance that recalls a daring young Coco Chanel. An absolutely modern composition with a strong yet surprisingly fresh character. COMPOSITION Sparks of fresh and vibrant orange immediately awaken the senses. A clear and sensual heart reveals the transparent accords of jasmine and May rose. The scent finally unfurls with the vibrant accents of patchouli and vetiver. ART OF PERFUMING The Eau de Parfum comes in a spray for easy application.

products.name: CHANEL CHANCE EAU TENDRE EAU DE PARFUM SPRAY
products.description: Product An enhanced interpretation of the unexpected fruity-floral fragrance, CHANCE EAU TENDRE Eau de Parfum sweeps you into an intensified whirlwind of tenderness. The signature CHANCE bottle is reinvented with a silver cap and golden accent. Composition A constellation of enveloping notes of Jasmine Absolute and Rose Essence dazzles with an intoxicatingly soft and enveloping trail for a radiant and feminine scent. Inspiration It comes and goes, it never stays put… and you only have a few seconds to seize your chance. It is unpredictable and appears when you least expect it, but if you decide to seize it, anything is possible. "A chance came up, I seized it." Mademoiselle Chanel knew that her real chance was the one of her own creation, a state of mind, a way of being.

products.name: Amouage Guidance Eau de Parfum
products.description: A spellbinding and novel interpretation of the Amouage triad of Rose, Frankincense and Ambergris. Guidance reads like a poem, smells like an embrace, and feels like a word of wisdom. Fragrance Family: Floral Woody Top Notes: Pear, Frankincense, Hazelnut Heart Notes: Saffron, Rose, Sambac Jasmine, Osmanthus Base Notes: Cistus, Sandalwood, Akigalawood, Ambergris, Vanilla

products.name: CHANEL BLEU DE CHANEL EAU DE PARFUM POUR HOMME SPRAY
products.description: PRODUCT Unexpected and undeniably bold. Fresh, clean and profoundly sensual, the woody, aromatic fragrance reveals the spirit of a man who chooses his own destiny with independence and determination - a man who defies convention. COMPOSITION The men's fragrance features afresh Citrus accord followed by ambery Cedar notes. Woods are amplified by TonkaBean and Vanilla for heightened sensuality. New Caledonian Sandalwood unfolds at the base for greater depth. ART OF PERFUMING The Eau de Parfum comes in a spray for easy application.

products.name: Thomas Kosmala No. 4 Apres l'Amour Eau de Parfum
products.description: This nuanced, multi-layered scent captures the erotic energy and languorous mood of skin meeting skin. Bitter orange and lemon zest add zip to the top notes before cooling down to a base of wood, musk and amber. Top Notes: Biter Orange, Lemon Zest Middle Notes: Aromatic, Fresh Spicy Base Notes: Dry Wood, Amber, Musk

products.name: CREED Aventus Fragrance
products.description: Aventus is bold and confident: the ultimate olfactive expression that has stood the test of time. The fragrance opens with fresh Calabrian bergamot harmonizing effortlessly with a signature pineapple accord for a bright and luminous introduction. As it evolves, smoky, leathery birch brings depth and structure, creating a composition that is both powerful and precisely balanced. A fragrance defined by clarity, confidence and enduring craft, Aventus leaves a refined yet assertive lasting impression. Olfactive Category: Dry Woods, Fresh, Citrus & Fruity Top Notes: Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon, Blackcurrant Leaf Accord Heart Notes: Pineapple Accord, Pink Pepper, Jasmine Accord Base Notes: Birch, Patchouli, Ambroxan, Cedarwood, Musk *The House of Creed is upgrading the packaging on select products. During this transition, the packaging may differ slightly from the images displayed, but rest assured, the contents will remain consistent with the brand's established formula and quality standards.

products.name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum
products.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 extrait de parfum intensifies the radiance of the three auras found in the eau de parfum without betraying the original inspiration. The perfumer's mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody extrait de perfume, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Jasmine Grandiflorum head note gently underscores the craftsman's voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with a musky and woody accord. Adding to the intensity of the extract, the perfume bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian extrait de parfum embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time. products.name: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum

Breezy jasmine facets, radiant saffron boost the ambergris mineral notes and the woody tones of freshly-cut cedar. Bright and sleek, Baccarat Rouge 540 eau de parfum caresses the skin like an amber and woody floral whisper. products.name: PARFUMS de MARLY Delina Exclusif Parfum
products.description: An opulent interpretation of the iconic Delina, Delina Exclusif Parfum reveals a richer, more sensual expression of the Maison's signature rose. Mysterious, sophisticated, and undeniably captivating, this luxurious fragrance envelops the skin in a sumptuous blend of radiant fruits, velvety florals, and warm amber nuances. The scent opens with a luminous burst of juicy pear, lychee, and sparkling bergamot, creating a vibrant and addictive introduction. At its heart, exquisite Damascena rose unfolds in full bloom, wrapped in a veil of smoky incense that adds depth, intrigue, and refinement. As the fragrance settles, creamy vanilla, soft musks, tonka bean, and moss create a warm, enveloping trail that lingers beautifully on the skin. The result is an intensely feminine fragrance that balances sensuality, elegance, and allure. Fragrance Family: Amber Floral Top Notes: Bergamot, Pear, Lychee Heart Notes: Damascena Rose, Incense Base Notes: Vanilla, Musks, Moss, Tonka Bean

products.name: PARFUMS de MARLY Valaya Eau de Parfum
products.description: A radiant aura with impalpable softness. This elegant floral-musky-woody fragrance created by Julien Sprecher is a unique play on traditional codes, materials, and subtle contrasts. An evocation of the skin caressed by a veil of cotton. Fresh top notes as bergamot, mandarin, and sweet white peach, lead to a blend of white flowers, settling on musk and ambrofix sensual base notes. Scent Family: Floral Musky Woody Top Notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Peach Heart Notes: Orange Flower, Nympheal, Vetiver Base Notes: Akigalawood, Ambrofix, Vanilla, Musk

products.name: CREED Absolu Aventus
products.description: Reimagine a classic with Absolu Aventus, a masterpiece that redefines the iconic pineapple heart of Aventus with a zesty twist of grapefruit and a smoky Haitian vetiver base. Absolu Aventus is a striking reimagination of classic Aventus, destined to deliver the ultimate olfactive experience to those who appreciate the extraordinary. A burst of citrus energy is instantly brought by bright bergamot with a twist of exquisitely fresh grapefruit, before revealing the signature pineapple and patchouli heart of its original inspiration. This spirit of Aventus is soon redefined as warming spices and smoky Haitian vetiver usher in, adding depth and complexity to the composition. A rare olfactive gem, Absolu Aventus promises a sensory experience that is beyond compare. Olfactive Category: Dry Woods, Fresh, Citrus, Fruity Top Notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Blackcurrant, Grapefruit, Ginger Heart Notes: Pineapple, Patchouli, Pink Pepper, Cardamom, Cinnamon Base Notes: Haitian Vetiver, Cashmeran Wood, Labdanum, Ambroxan, Musk, Oakmoss

products.name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU EAU DE PARFUM SPRAY
products.description: The ambery COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU scent embodies the power of attraction at its most potent, with a pull impossible to resist. An Eau de Parfum whose intensity is magnetic, designed by Chanel in-house perfumer creator Olivier Polge. It sparks a liberating rush each time it is applied. The scent starts to develop with its opening notes, revealing a lychee-grapefruit accord. A floral heart of rose and jasmine enhances its charm. The enchantment of this Eau de Parfum lies in woody-ambery base notes. Patchouli is elevated by ambery notes with vanilla accents and notes of vetiver. How to Use: To express the full power of the fragrance, spray COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Eau de Parfum in a sweeping motion.

products.name: CREED Iris Debonair Eau de Parfum
products.description: Iris Debonair, an addictive fougère floral fragrance where the precision of British tailoring meets the art of French Haute Perfumery. A luminous bergamot, co-infused with absinthe leaves, opens with intentional charm. The finest Creed-sourced English lavender from Kent brings crisp, herbaceous clarity. Deeper in the palette, French iris pallida from Les Landes, grown for over three years, casts magnetic shades of pale blue. This is a fragrance worn as a seal of elegance. Fragrance Family: Fougère Floral Head Notes: Bergamot & Absinthe, Pink Pepper, Cardamom Heart Notes: English Lavender, Violet Leaf, Fig Pulp Accord Base Notes: French Iris Pallida, Ambrette, Amberwood

products.name: Lancome Renergie Lift Makeup Foundation
products.description: Up to 12-Hours of Lifting, Hydration, and Radiance  What It is: A luminous foundation with up to 12-hours of lifting and hydration for medium-to-full coverage, re-formulated with added active skincare ingredients. What It Does: A comfortable, medium-to-full coverage foundation formulated with anti-aging properties the Rénergie line of products is known for. Including SPF 27, it lifts and hydrates for up to 12-hours, while, minimizing the appearance of dark spots for a luminous finish.    How To Apply Rénergie Lift Makeup Foundation:    After cleansing skin, apply a face primer.  Lancôme suggests La Base Pro Perfecting Makeup Primer. Using a makeup brush, beauty blender tool (use wet for even more coverage) or fingers, apply Rénergie Lift Makeup Foundation onto skin for desired coverage.   Finish makeup application with Lancôme’s Blush Subtil on cheeks, L’Absolu Rouge lipstick and any one of Lancôme’s award-winning mascaras for that extra dose of Parisian chic! Tools To Use For Desired Foundation Makeup Coverage:    For medium coverage, use sponge or beauty blender tool (lightly damp or dry).  For full-coverage makeup, use fingers and/or a wet beauty blender tool. What Is My Skin tone?  What Is Your Skin's Undertone? Lancôme’s products are organized by both intensity (I, II, III, IV, V) and by undertone (C, N, W.) Intensity:   The intensity of a Lancôme product is organized by surface skin color. Hues are organized by Intensity I, Intensity II, Intensity III, Intensity IV, and Intensity V.   Undertones:    Cool (C) undertones = foundations and powders look slightly pinkish.  Bare skin has a rosy undertone and usually burns easily in the sun.  Veins appear blue.   Neutral (N) undertones = bare skin is a bit more even-toned, not too pink or too golden. These usually work best for olive skin/olive undertones (“green”), but it is still best to test out first on the skin for the perfect match! Veins appear in a mix of green and blue.   Warm (W) undertones = bare skin appears golden/yellow and tans easily in the sun. Olive skin can sometimes skew warm as well for those with a slightly more gold hue. Veins appear green.

Features and Benefits: Ultra-versatile formula Smooth and creamy texture Wide range of Artist-approved shades Designed to complement all MAC lip colours to create limitless combos Won't skip or drag Applies quickly and precisely How to Use: Before Lipstick: To naturally define lips, start by outlining the Cupid's bow. Blend with a 316S Brush to create a natural-looking gradient. After Lipstick: To add extra definition, line lips after applying your Lipstick. With Lipglass: Outline or fill in lips completely, then layer on Lipglass for a high-shine look. Liner Only: Shade and fill in lips.

I know it’s from his legs rubbing together while he’s walking, but the material there wears down so quickly and then eventually tears from the material getting so thinned out. I’m not over exaggerating when I say they literally last him one month before this happens. But they’re the best pants otherwise and he likes the way they fit and feel, so we keep buying them each month anyway. He said they feel lightweight, they don’t feel too hot while being outside in the heat and they give him a clean cut professional look while at work. They can be dressed up or down. So even with the fast wear and tear, I’d still recommend these for a nice pair of pants. Just don’t expect them to last too long.

reviews.date: So nice, I had to buy it twice.
reviews.body: The Coach Cargo Tabby Soft Leather is genuinely my favorite bag of all time. I own Hermès, Gucci, Prada, Louis Vuitton, and plenty of Coach, and in my opinion, no other bag compares to this one. The leather is incredibly soft and supple, and it just feels luxurious. I’ve had mine for about a year now, and it still has that amazing fresh-leather smell. It’s also surprisingly roomy and holds so much. The little compartments on the front and sides are more aesthetic for me personally. I love the slightly grungy, utilitarian look they give the bag, although you absolutely can fit things in them. I

reviews.author: 15 days ago
reviews.date: I’ve had this bag in black for two years. It’s my road dawg. The outside pockets are perfect for AirPods, short lipgloss, keys, small sanitizer or mini wipes. The back outside pocket is meh. My large phone won’t fit in that pocket. On the inside, I can fit a full sized wallet. I’d recommend a smaller option to conserve space. True confession—I love this purse so much that I bought the same exact design in the 36 when it was briefly available.

reviews.author: 2 months ago
reviews.date: Quite possibly one of the most functional and still beautifully designed Coach bags of all time! Lots of room inside, functional cargo pockets, perfect sized cell phone back pocket, fantastic magnetic clasp and zipper pocket in interior. I wear mine with both the shoulder strap and the crossbody - the buckles allow you to do this - dog collar clasps would be better, but it's fine. I do hope that Coach brings this bag back in more colors - I bought the Maple this go round and now I think I have all the colors. Gorgeous bag and the leather is beautiful.

If you tuck in your top they show, if

reviews.title: Picky shopper
reviews.author: 6 months ago
reviews.date: I bought this skirt after looking at a very similar RL version that was 5x the price. I have a lot of quality goat and bovine suede and leather. I was not sure on the size, I would normally buy small but medium or large in leather/suede. After several conversations with Microsoft Copilot I settled on the large; Copilot deeply explained why I may not be happy with the fit in certain areas based on the Dillards information and the information I provided. I bought the large and tried it on today. Copilot was right, no exchange for me and I cannot imagine paying 5x the price, even for goat suede (which I love). I think I can wear it three seasons (sandals or boots) due to the fringe style (not overly warm. Note: there are strange ties/bows on one side that look frilly; no problem, they are removable (just untie them and slip them out). IMO if you did not want to tuck your top in they would create bulk, then you need a jacket, then it's a potential return. This skirt is so cute its not just for the cowgirl in you.

I have always been partial to the leather bands as it allows for more adjustability. Overall, a great looking nicely fitting watch

reviews.title: Hem
reviews.author: Steve1795
reviews.body: FINALLY a Minecraft watch that actually gets it. The lava block, the warden lurking in the shadows, that tiny sliver of an enderman eye peeking out — way more iconic than another mooshroom cow or flower couldve been. And love that its not split into a "boys" and a "girls" version, just one solid design for anyone who actually plays. The all-metal band feels premium and sturdy. Bonus: wipes clean in two seconds after a day of building, no fabric soaking up grime like some watches. Worth every penny, 10/10 would buy again.
